item: R845 (row 452): no qualification verdict until a source has 5 articles and one published in the last 180 days
summary: The field analysis (#2418) found verdicts given on a handful of pages or on years-old ones. A source is now judged only once it has at least 5 stored articles (quarantined ones left out, as the verdict leaves them out) and its newest article was published at most 180 days ago, by the article's own published date: the fetch date never counts, an undated article never makes a source recent, and a date later than now is no date. Until then the attempt is not_enough_data, logged like no_evidence: Source.status, enabled and the qualified stamp untouched, the ladder neither advanced nor reset, the re-verification clock unmoved. Because the clock stays, a re-check that ends this way waits 30 days before the same source is tried again, so a dormant source cannot take a re-check slot and a trial fetch on every pass; a new candidate rotates like a no-evidence one. The check runs after the off-site hold, which reads where the pages came from and holds a taken-over domain however few its articles. The pass and the bulk job report not_enough_data and how many of those have no dated article; the Sources panel's final line says '{n} sources with not enough data yet ({m} of them have no dated articles)', and the source panel shows 'not enough data yet' beside the status it keeps, with the reason on hover (6 keys x12). CRITERIA_VERSION moves to oo-source-qualification-5, a label only. No stage bump, no re-extraction, no schema change.
